description: This file implements the core functions of an HTTP Advanced Proxy Object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and cleanup routines. It defines how the object manages internal components such as interfaces and worker objects, and provides mechanisms to set up its environment within a larger system.

classes.name: HTTP_ADVANCED_PROXY_OBJECT
classes.description: Main class representing the HTTP Advanced Proxy Object, which includes properties for interfaces, control flags, and internal components such as worker objects and pools.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpApoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of the HTTP Advanced Proxy Object, initializing its core properties and setting up function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the proxy object and frees all associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enables the proxy object to instantiate and associate required internal components like interfaces and worker objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs comprehensive initialization of the proxy object, including setting default properties, function pointers, and internal state.
